concerns: The reading for item 17, {食|ぐ}, is incorrect. The kanji 食 when followed by ぐい (as in 大食い) should be read as くい, not ぐい. The rendaku applies to the entire compound, not just the second kanji in isolation.
The reading for item 21, {食|く}, is incorrect. In the compound 食いしん坊, the kanji 食 is read as くい, not く.
